Dinesh vs State Of Haryana on 28 August, 2024 
Author: Pankaj Jain
Bench: Pankaj Jain
 Neutral Citation No:=2024:PHHC:111096
Crm-M-40626-2024 1
219
 In The High Court Of Punjab And Haryana
 At Chandigarh
 Crm-M-40626-2024
 Date of decision : 28.08.2024
Dinesh ....Petitioner
 Versus
State Of Haryana ...Respondent
Coram: Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Pankaj Jain 
Present : Mr. Bijender S. Dhankhar, Advocate  for the petitioner. 
 Mr. Apurv Garg, Sr. DAG, Haryana. 
PANKAJ JAIN, J. (ORAL) 
This petition has been filed under Section 439 Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail to the petitioner in case F.I.R. No.124 dated 21.02.2021 registered for the offences punishable under Sections 120-B,
148, 186, 302, 332, 353, 379B/149 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (Section 379B of IPC added later on) and Section 45 of the Prisons Act, 1894 at Police Station City, Sonipat, District Sonipat. 
2. Custody Certificate of the petitioner has been filed today in Court. The same is taken on record. 
3. FIR was registered on the information supplied by Superintendent of Jail, Sonipat to Police Station Sonipat which reads as under :
Dinesh vs State Of Haryana on 28 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/178304662/
1 1 of 4 Neutral Citation No:=2024:PHHC:111096 "xxxx For taking legal action against under trials confine in reference to the aforesaid, you are hereby apprised about the aforesaid subject that today on dated 21/02/2021 at about 08:30 AM in the morning,
under the supervision Head Warden Kadam Singh, Barack No.283, food was being distributed to the under trials of Block No.8 in Block Safety Ward, B.D. as usual for every day, at that time, under trials Dinesh S/o Jagdish, R/o Nahri and Rohit S/o Jai Bhagwan, R/o Mukimpur, called and nabbed Naveen @ Mandhori in their Block-8 and started assaulting. At this time, Rajneesh @ Palu S/o Roshan Lal, R/o Rabhra,
Pawan S/o Ram Kishore, R/o Rewari and Deepak S/o Rampal, R/o Ramgarh, Anil S/o Ramphal, R/o Gagana, ran and caught hold of Warden Kadam Singh, Belt No.283 and started assaulted. In the meanwhile, other inmates that included Amit @
Mota S/o Mahesh, R/o Harsana, Mahipal @ Mahala S/o Rajbal, R/o Jagsi, Ravinder @Thekedar S/o Mehar Singh, R/o Gagana, Praveen S/o Ved Parkash R/o Tiharpur,
Ravinder @ Raghubir, R/o Surya Nagar, Hisar, Rohit @ Neetu S/o Kaptan, Deepak @ Fort S/o Vinod, residents of Karewri, Sonipat, Geetu @ Parinde S/o Ashok, R/o Thana Khurd under conspiracy entered Chakki No.20 in Ward-D and attacked inmate Jagbir S/o Ramphal over head and chest and gave injuries with pointed articles and strangled him with cloth. On receiving information of this incident, other staff of jail reached the spot and right away took inmate Jagbir to hospital. From where it was informed that inmate Jagbir has died. In this incident, Head Warden Kadam Singh and Naveen Mandhori suffered injuries, their MLRS are attached alongwith. Therefore, you are requested that F.I.R. be registered and adequate legal action be taken against accused. Sd/- Ankit Malik, D.S.P., District Jail, Sonipat (Ankit Malik)" 
4. Counsel for the petitioner submits that one of the eye-witnesses namely Kadam Singh who was examined as PW4 and also brother of the complainant has not attributed any role to the petitioner qua the deceased. 
2 of 4 Neutral Citation No:=2024:PHHC:111096 He further submits that so far as the allegation levelled in the FIR against the petitioner is w.r.t. nabbing Naveen @ Mandhori and not w.r.t. the deceased.
5. I have heard counsel for the petitioner and have carefully gone through records of the case.
6. Bare perusal of the FIR reveals a gory incident that too within the jail premises. Even as per the allegations levelled in the present FIR, it is the petitioner who initiated the whole incident by nabbing Naveen @ Mandhori. Details of pending cases against the petitioner as mentioned in the custody certificate are tabulated as under:
Sr. FIR No. Date of FIR Police Station Offences No. Under Section 1 568/2022 04.10.2022 City Jagadhri, Yamuna 42-A of Prisons Act Nagar 2 580/2011 N/A Partapur, Meerut 302 IPC, 3(2)5 SC/ST Act 3 188/2018 N/A Israna, Panipat 379-B,
34 IPC 4 187/2018 N/A Israna, Panipat 307, 379-B IPC, 25/54/59 of Arms Act 5 Dinesh vs State Of Haryana on 28 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/178304662/
2 241/2018 N/A Ladwa, Kurukshetra 364-A, 395 IPC, 25/54/59 of Arms Act 6 699/2018 N/A City Rohtak, Rohtak 395, 397, 120-B IPC 7 66/2018 N/A Baroda,
Sonipat 302-2(1) IPC, 6 POCSO Act, 307, 379-B, 120-B, 34 IPC 8 442/2018 N/A Murthal, Sonipat 307, 332, 353, 399, 402, 412, 420, 467, 468, 471 IPC 7. Apart from these, State Counsel submits that the petitioner has earned two convictions as well. 
The fact is not disputed.
8. It is evident that despite earning multiple convictions and having been booked multiple times,
petitioner instead of being remorseful and showing signs of reformation, has remained incorrigible. 
Taking law 3 of 4 Neutral Citation No:=2024:PHHC:111096 into his hands even while serving conviction and that too by attacking jail officials, the petitioner has shown scant respect for law. 
9. Keeping in view the seriousness of the allegations levelled in the present FIR, the fact that the petitioner over the years has shown no sign of improvement, this Court does not find any reason to grant bail to the petitioner. Resultantly, the instant petition is dismissed. 
August 28, 2024 (Pankaj Jain)
